title: STRICT ALONE WITHOUT FLOOR: producers fail with no guilds and no floor?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Owner-ordered strict alone test: the 0.05 floor carried producers alone on 33/36; without it, initial stock plus construction kickstart alone must not carry them. Heterotroph income impossible (graze explicit 0, meat preset 0), no seeded decomposers.
preregistration.prediction: prod == 0 on at least 30/36 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion). Nothing else predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED (reliance not obligate even floorless) if prod > 0 on 7 or more of 36 seeds. Sub-cases as before: (a) persist with no decomposers ever sampled — initial stock suffices, clause closed; (b) decomposer roles re-emerge and track recovery — function-dependence holds but seeding-independence fails, clause needs restating.
preregistration.notPredicted: Consumer transients, decomposer re-emergence counts (descriptive), B/D trajectories (descriptive).
confoundsControlled: Same 36 seeds, horizon, engine as producer-alone; differences stated: nfloor 0.05 -> 0 only (founders slot 0 and graze explicit 0 retained)
Kickstart is the existing construction stock only; abiotic floor fully removed
Dormancy/spore support retained (support is not seeding); disease/sat/cyc/regen/rsur identical
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: producers = 0 at tick 6000 on at least 30/36 seeds
